scripts.build: node ../../scripts/check-benchmark-sync.mjs && node ../../scripts/check-benchmark-live.mjs --predeploy-if-production && pnpm --filter @maskera/core --filter maskera build && node scripts/fetch-model.mjs && node ../../scripts/run-release-benchmarks.mjs --if-production && pnpm test && vite build && node scripts/prune-build-models.mjs
scripts.audit: pnpm run audit:lighthouse && pnpm run audit:a11y
scripts.a11y:run: for route in / /utvecklare /integritet /testdata /integritetspolicy /tjanster /traffsakerhet /sakerhet /en /en/developers /en/privacy /en/test-data /en/privacy-policy /en/services /en/accuracy /en/security; do pa11y --config .pa11yrc.json --level error --threshold 0 "http://127.0.0.1:4173$route" || exit 1; done
scripts.a11y:review: for route in / /utvecklare /integritet /testdata /integritetspolicy /tjanster /traffsakerhet /sakerhet /en /en/developers /en/privacy /en/test-data /en/privacy-policy /en/services /en/accuracy /en/security; do pa11y --config .pa11yrc.json --level error --threshold 0 --include-warnings "http://127.0.0.1:4173$route" || exit 1; done
